summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Voiladi Likes and Chats tabs. Verified soft-UI design implementation (raised cards, floating bottom nav, empty states with 3D art), all interactive elements, tab filtering, search functionality, and responsiveness across multiple viewports. Dark mode rendering confirmed. No console errors detected.
passed_tests: Login flow: POST /api/auth/login with neo1788974536@example.com works, tokens stored in localStorage, navigates to /discover
Floating bottom nav: Present on all 5 pages (/discover, /explore, /likes, /chats, /profile), inset 12px from sides (369px width in 393px viewport), active tab highlighted correctly
Chats /chats: Header shows round search button (data-testid chats-search-button) and compose button (chats-compose-button), title 'Messages' (chats-title), subtitle 'Your conversations'
Chats tabs: All three tabs (chats-tab-all, chats-tab-matches, chats-tab-unread) work correctly and filter conversations
Chats search: Clicking search button toggles search input (chats-search-input), typing filters rows (tested with 'Hana', found 1 result), clicking X closes search
Chats compose: Compose button opens drawer (compose-drawer) with match list, clicking match navigates to /chats/<id>
Chats rows: Raised card style (vo-soft-row), avatar, name (Hana), last message (chats-last-message), time (Yesterday), clicking opens chat room

Chats EMPTY state: API interception of GET /api/matches returns empty array → big rounded card with bubbles SVG illustration, 'No conversations yet', description, 'Find people' button (chats-find-people-button) navigates to /explore, footer 'Start something new'
Likes /likes: Header has round more button (likes-more-button) opening menu (likes-more-menu) with sort options (likes-sort-newest, likes-sort-oldest) and Super Likes filter (likes-filter-super)
Likes title row: 'Likes' (likes-title), subtitle 'People who liked you', raised pill (likes-count) shows heart + count '5' matching actual row count
Likes tabs: All three tabs (likes-tab-all, likes-tab-received, likes-tab-sent) filter rows correctly
Likes rows: Raised card style, 56px avatar, name + age (e.g., 'Riya 23'), 'Liked you 13h ago' or 'Super Liked you 13h ago' subtitle, chevron, clicking opens profile sheet
Likes row menu: Menu button (likes-row-menu) opens dropdown with View profile, Like back, Pass, Report, Block options
Likes row actions: Clicking row (likes-row-open) opens profile sheet with action buttons (sheet-like-button, sheet-pass-button), Report opens iOS-style dialog (report-dialog), Cancel closes it
Responsiveness: At 360x640 and 430x932, both Chats and Likes pages render without horizontal scroll, empty states fit above floating nav
Dark mode: Toggle from /settings works, dark class applied, /likes and /chats render correctly in dark mode (no white artifacts, proper contrast)
Console: No runtime errors or React warnings on any tested pages
